metadata.title: The capillary $L_{p}$ dual Christoffel-Minkowski problem for $1<p<q\leq k+1$ with $1\leq k\leq n$
metadata.abstract: This paper is concerned with a capillary $L_p$ Christoffel--Minkowski-type problem involving the prescription of a class of $L_p$ geometric measures formed by the $k$-th capillary area measure and the $q$-th dual curvature measure. By establishing a gradient estimate, we prove the existence of an even, smooth, strictly convex solution in the parameter range $1<p<q\leq k+1$, where $1\leq k\leq n$.

analysis.progressType: 毛细 Lp 对偶 Christoffel–Minkowski 可解性
analysis.workSummary: 通过梯度估计，在 1<p<q≤k+1、1≤k≤n 范围为指定毛细面积与对偶曲率组合测度的问题构造偶、光滑、严格凸解。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩展一类毛细凸几何测度处方问题的存在范围。
analysis.limitations: 摘要给出存在性，未声称唯一性；参数区间及偶对称设定须保留。
analysis.priorityReason: 扩展一类毛细凸几何测度处方问题的存在范围。
